blocks.html: Описание Элемента: Фонарик, который можно заспавнить и подобрать игроком
Важно: Всё общее наследуется от Element. Собственных свойств у Flashlight нет. См. Elements > Element

blocks.code:
import pse

pse.initialize()

flashlight = pse.Flashlight()
flashlight.create(location=(0, 0, -100))

# Доступны только общие свойства Element
flashlight.location = (10, 0, -100)
flashlight.visibility = True

blocks.html: • RuntimeError - игра не запущена или вернула код ошибки
Element Description: A flashlight that can be spawned and picked up by the player
Important: Everything common is inherited from Element. Flashlight has no unique properties. See Elements > Element

blocks.code:
import pse

pse.initialize()

flashlight = pse.Flashlight()
flashlight.create(location=(0, 0, -100))

# Only common Element properties are available
flashlight.location = (10, 0, -100)
flashlight.visibility = True

blocks.html: • RuntimeError - game not running or returned an error code
